watches.name: Field Watch MkIII Standard (Vintage Black) - Nylon Strap
watches.description: Clean & uncomplicated reliability Influenced by the utilitarian aesthetic of WWII-era military watches, the Lightwell MkIII is a time-only field watch that combines modern solar technology with no-nonsense functionality. Its water-resistant steel case and scratch-proof sapphire crystal provides rugged versatility, while its solar-powered movement offers low-maintenance reliability by constantly charging under natural and artificial light. It's high-contrast dial and luminous hands make it easy to read the time in almost every environment.

watches.name: Field Watch MkIII - Petite (Rose Gold / Black)
watches.description: Compact Durability The Field Watch MkIII is our take on the idealized everyday watch for modestly-sized wrists. Measuring just 30.5mm wide, the Field Watch MkIII's compact size offers a strong balance of style and utility. Designed for daily use, the watch features a low-maintenance solar-powered movement from Seiko, a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, luminous hands dial, and water resistance to 100 meters. Each set comes with two straps - leather and nylon - that let the watch transition seamlessly between the office and the great outdoors.

watches.name: Field Watch Mark I (Gunmetal) - Modern Leather Strap
watches.description: Meet the Lightwell Field Watch We’ve seen watch trends come and go, but one thing has remained a constant for the last fifty years: the 38mm field watch. It’s a hard-wearing totem of sorts, but one that’s about as classic an adventure partner as it gets with three hands, a brushed steel case, and a no-nonsense numeric dial. But we didn’t want the Lightwell to just look the part, so we started with a special light-powered Seiko movement and fortified it with a 316L surgical grade stainless steel case, a scratch-proof sapphire crystal, a screwdown crown and caseback to ensure 100 meters of water resistance, and a lifetime of faithful, worry-free reliability.

It’s a hard-wearing totem of sorts, but one that’s about as classic an adventure partner as it gets with three hands, a brushed steel case, and a no-nonsense numeric dial. But we didn’t want the Lightwell to just look the part, so we started with a solar powered Seiko movement and fortified it with a 316L surgical grade stainless steel case, a scratch-proof sapphire crystal, a screwdown crown and caseback to ensure 100 meters of water resistance, and a lifetime of faithful, worry-free reliability.
